title: SupersededIdentifiers
description: contracts/superseded.v1.json: SPEC Appendix A as data, consumed by scripts/check-forbidden.mjs. The shape mirrors what that checker accepts (it rejects unknown keys), so this schema must not allow more. A literal pattern is a case-sensitive substring; a regex pattern is an ECMAScript RegExp source compiled with flags and matched line by line. Appendix A items that plain text matching cannot catch reliably are listed in contracts/README.md, not here.

flags.description: Regex only: any of i, m, s, u (e.g. i for HTTP header names).

allow.description: Repo-relative path globs (** crosses directories, * and ? do not) where the identifier is permitted.

level.description: warn: reported only, for an identifier that legacy code still uses until the stream owning that code removes it; flip to error in that PR.
